recipe.name: Pasta with Chickpeas
recipe.description: Pasta tossed in a creamy, garlicky sauce of half-crushed chickpeas with rosemary and a whisper of cayenne. A quick dinner for two, finished with grated cheese.

ingredients.ingredient_name: Good-quality pasta (e.g., fusilli lunghi, penne, or orecchiette)

steps: Boil the pasta in a large pot of salted water, following the packet time.
Warm a generous glug of olive oil in a skillet on medium while the pasta cooks. Add the garlic and soften it gently without letting it color.
Stir in the chickpeas, then crush about half of them with the back of a spoon until the pan looks creamy.
Add the rosemary and a tiny pinch of cayenne pepper and stir them through.
Scoop a ladle of the pasta cooking water into the chickpeas before draining. Simmer for about 1 minute.
Drain the pasta, tip it into the chickpea pan and stir until every piece is coated.
Serve straight away with grated Parmigiano on top.
You nailed it! Grab a plate and dig in.
